BSBM tools 0.2 generator: GPL-3.0, run as a separate program; this run reuses its generated benchmark data.

settings.method: Each engine ran alone during timed requests. Both passes used the same data hashes and binary hashes. BSBM samples pool three fixed instances. SP2Bench summaries use means and sample standard deviations; BSBM summaries use pooled medians. The matched peers are the engines behind the published losses, with additional measured peers shown explicitly.

biq2_independent_oracle.method: RDF-set feature intersection, Product type membership, anchor exclusion, descending integer count and ascending IRI, top10.
